_note: Approved/limited_use snapshot only. Not the full research dataset. A phrase here is a candidate to consider when it fits the exact meaning, platform, audience and register of the copy you're writing — never insert it just because it's listed.

phrases.content_surface: page title, meta, H1, FAQ, JSON-LD alternateName
phrases.usage_guidance: Use as the primary umbrella term for the whole Unicode-styling category — it is the single most load-bearing IT phrase on the site (own hub page, own dictionary row, own hero/H1).
phrases.good_example: Caratteri speciali da copiare e incollare
phrases.avoid_when: n/a — safe, mainstream, no register risk

phrases.content_surface: editorial how-to article title/body
phrases.usage_guidance: Good for how-to/FAQ framing ('come scrivere con font diversi'); the site's own transactional page already uses the platform-first form 'font per Instagram' as its slug/H1 pattern — keep both, they serve different search stages (how-to vs. tool).
phrases.good_example: Come scrivere con font diversi su Instagram

phrases.content_surface: page title, H1, meta, FAQ, JSON-LD alternateName ('Scritte Strane')
phrases.usage_guidance: Use for the 'unusual/eye-catching' styling angle, distinct from the softer 'aesthetic' angle (IT-004) and the more literally-descriptive 'caratteri speciali' (IT-001).
phrases.good_example: Scritte Particolari da Copiare e Incollare

phrases.register: casual, youth/Gen-Z coded, borrowed English adjective inside an Italian noun phrase
phrases.content_surface: page title, H1, meta, homepage FAQ category ('Scritte aesthetic, scritte stilizzate e simboli')
phrases.usage_guidance: Primary term for the soft/curated aesthetic angle. Site FAQ explicitly notes 'Scritta stilizzata' and 'scritte aesthetic' are treated as interchangeable by users — safe to keep both.
phrases.good_example: Scritte aesthetic da copiare
phrases.avoid_when: n/a — mainstream youth-register term, not niche

phrases.content_surface: page title, H1, meta, homepage copy ('le scritte belle che generi qui restano belle...')
phrases.usage_guidance: Use as the plain-language entry point for users who wouldn't search 'aesthetic' — it is the site's broadest, least jargon-y style term.
phrases.good_example: Scritte belle da copiare

phrases.content_surface: page title, H1, meta, JSON-LD alternateName, FAQ
phrases.usage_guidance: Primary term for the whole nickname vertical. Note 'nickname' itself is a straight English loanword fully naturalized in Italian gaming/social register (no native replacement is used anywhere in the corpus).
phrases.good_example: Scritte per nickname e nomi stilosi

phrases.english_concept: symbols/frames used to decorate a nickname
phrases.content_surface: nickname page decoration-tab UI label ('Cornici'), editorial body
phrases.usage_guidance: 'Cornici' is the correct, already-shipped UI label for the frames decoration tab; 'simboli per nick' is the descriptive search-style phrasing found in competitor evidence.
phrases.good_example: una cornice ꧁ ꧂, una stella ★, una spada ⚔

phrases.content_surface: how-to editorial articles; site FAQ ('come avere un nome invisibile in Free Fire o Mobile Legends')
phrases.usage_guidance: Strong, mainstream, high-intent gaming phrase — use as the primary term for the blank-name use case; distinct from the broader 'testo invisibile' (IT-019), which covers all zero-width/blank Unicode characters, not just game names.
phrases.good_example: Come faccio un nome invisibile su Free Fire o Mobile Legends?

phrases.content_surface: page title, H1, meta, Article JSON-LD alternateName
phrases.usage_guidance: Use as the umbrella technical term on the reference/library-style page; 'nome invisibile' (IT-008) and 'nome vuoto'/'spazio bianco' (from GLHF) are the game-specific and colloquial variants of the same concept.
phrases.good_example: Testo Invisibile (Carattere Invisibile) — Copia e Incolla Spazio Vuoto

phrases.english_concept: boxes / question marks (glyph fallback rendering failure)
phrases.content_surface: FAQ items across many pages (convertitore-di-caratteri, font-facebook, font-instagram, font-telegram, font-tiktok, font-whatsapp, nickname, scritte-particolari, snapchat)
phrases.usage_guidance: This is one of the most-repeated, best-evidenced native phrases in the whole IT corpus — used consistently and naturally across at least 9 different pages. Keep 'quadratino (▯)' as the canonical singular form with the glyph shown inline, as the repo already does.
phrases.good_example: Perché alcuni caratteri diventano quadratini quando li incollo?
phrases.avoid_when: n/a — already the house-standard phrasing, do not replace with a more literal/technical term like 'tofu' or 'glifo mancante'

phrases.english_concept: username field vs. display-name field distinction
phrases.content_surface: FAQ items on nickname, caratteri-speciali, homepage
phrases.usage_guidance: This distinction is repeated consistently across the corpus and is clearly a core teaching point of the site — preserve the exact 'nome utente (@)' / 'nome visualizzato' pairing rather than varying the terms page to page, since consistency itself is part of what makes the explanation land.
phrases.good_example: Il nome utente (l'handle con la @) accetta solo lettere semplici... Il nome visualizzato — quello che appare in grande sopra la bio — invece li accetta quasi sempre.

phrases.content_surface: titles, meta, CTAs, FAQ, throughout nearly every page
phrases.usage_guidance: Foundational term, already correctly and extremely consistently used ('copia e incolla' as the two-verb form, 'copia-incolla' as the hyphenated noun form) — no changes needed.
phrases.good_example: Caratteri Speciali da Copiare e Incollare

phrases.content_surface: page title, H1, meta, FAQ
phrases.usage_guidance: Own dedicated page — use as a transactional-intent variant alongside 'caratteri speciali' (IT-001) and 'font particolari' (IT-022).
phrases.good_example: I font copiati funzionano su tutte le app?

phrases.content_surface: dedicated counter tool page (H1: 'Verificatore Limite di Caratteri per Piattaforma'), nickname FAQ
phrases.usage_guidance: Also connects to the game-nickname domain, where the site's own nickname FAQ separately warns 'alcune lettere decorate contano doppio' (some decorated letters count double) — a genuinely useful, specific piece of jargon worth reusing when explaining why a styled name can silently exceed a game's limit.
phrases.good_example: Verificatore Limite di Caratteri per Piattaforma

phrases.native_phrase: font per tatuaggio / font per tatuaggi
phrases.content_surface: usecase page; matches Aranzulla 'Migliori font per tatuaggi' editorial
phrases.usage_guidance: Aranzulla's own framing pairs this with 'elegante o romantico' and 'corsivi' for cursive scripts, and warns 'i caratteri troppo elaborati possono risultare difficili da leggere' — both are usable content angles for the tattoo usecase page beyond what's there today.
phrases.good_example: Se preferisci qualcosa di più elegante o romantico, i corsivi rappresentano spesso la soluzione ideale.

phrases.english_concept: invisible text (general zero-width/blank Unicode reference page)
phrases.content_surface: page title, H1, meta
phrases.usage_guidance: Keep distinct from 'nome invisibile' (IT-008), which is the narrower, higher-intent gaming-specific query; this page correctly serves the broader reference intent (bio spacing, blank WhatsApp messages, etc.).
phrases.good_example: Testo Invisibile & Carattere Invisibile

phrases.english_concept: strange/weird writing (colloquial synonym for stylized text)
phrases.content_surface: JSON-LD alternateName on scritte-particolari page; external editorial (Aranzulla 'Come fare scritte strane su WhatsApp')
phrases.usage_guidance: Already captured as an alternateName synonym on the live scritte-particolari page; confirmed as a genuinely used external search/editorial phrase via Aranzulla's own WhatsApp-specific article title.
phrases.good_example: Come fare scritte strane su WhatsApp

phrases.content_surface: homepage editorial copy, locales/it.json useCases
phrases.usage_guidance: Confirmed both natively on the homepage and externally via Aranzulla's Instagram-fonts article ('font particolari' as the generic label for decorative typefaces) — safe, mainstream, dual-sourced term.
phrases.good_example: Rendi la tua bio riconoscibile con font particolari, scritte stilizzate e simboli.

phrases.english_concept: specific invisible-character codepoints named by the community (Hangul Filler etc.)
phrases.content_surface: site's own testo-invisibile page (codepoint labels); external how-to articles
phrases.usage_guidance: The community consistently names the exact character (not just 'an invisible character') when giving instructions — e.g. multiplayer.it explicitly names 'Hangul Filler U+3164'. The site's testo-invisibile page already labels every button with the precise Unicode name/codepoint, which matches this community convention well.
phrases.good_example: Il trucco prevede di copiare il carattere speciale "ㅤ"... chiamato Hangul Filler U+3164.

phrases.content_surface: homepage FAQ, aesthetic description list
phrases.usage_guidance: Pairs naturally with the tattoo/handwriting-anxiety job already on file and with Aranzulla's own tattoo-font framing ('se preferisci qualcosa di più elegante o romantico, i corsivi...') — a genuinely cross-validated phrase for the 'elegant/romantic' register specifically, distinct from the broader 'aesthetic' register.
phrases.good_example: Belli da bio: script, corsivo elegante, monoline, fancy.

phrases.content_surface: alphabet-row labels (nickname, caratteri-speciali), FAQ style lists
phrases.usage_guidance: Good example of the site correctly using the real Italian typographic term instead of leaving 'small caps' untranslated (contrast with 'nickname'/'bio'/'caption', which stay as English loanwords) — worth preserving as the house standard.
phrases.good_example: Maiuscoletto — ᴀʙᴄᴅᴇꜰɢʜɪᴊᴋʟᴍɴᴏᴘǫʀꜱᴛᴜᴠᴡxʏᴢ

phrases.content_surface: dedicated category page; nickname/scritte-aesthetic FAQs
phrases.usage_guidance: The category page's own FAQ explicitly links 'gotico' to gaming nickname use ('Il gotico grassetto passa nel nickname di giochi come Free Fire, Fortnite e Roblox') — reinforces IT-015's 'nick dark/tryhard' pairing with cornici like ꧁꧂/༒.
phrases.good_example: ꧁༒𝕾𝖍𝖆𝖉𝖔𝖜༒꧂

phrases.content_surface: Italian-market name-generator sites (uniquenamegenerators.com/it, spinxo.com/it) and how-to sites (glhf.online) that keep 'tryhard'/'sweaty' in English inside otherwise-Italian copy
phrases.usage_guidance: Confirms IT-015's repo phrasing ('nick dark / tryhard') is on-trend: Italian gaming sites consistently borrow 'tryhard'/'sweaty' wholesale rather than coining an Italian equivalent (no native replacement term found anywhere in this research). Safe to keep 'tryhard' untranslated in gaming-nickname copy.
phrases.good_example: Pseudo Tryhard — Generatore di nomi utente
phrases.avoid_when: outside gaming context — the term has no meaning/currency in general social (Instagram/TikTok bio) copy

phrases.english_concept: caption (borrowed English word, dominant on the homepage)
phrases.register: casual, youth-coded, especially natural for TikTok
phrases.content_surface: homepage title/meta/FAQ (dominant usage), locales/it.json use-case card ('Caption TikTok aesthetic')
phrases.usage_guidance: This is the numerically dominant form site-wide (appears ~15+ times on the homepage alone vs. 'didascalia' appearing once, on a different page) — treat 'caption' as the de facto primary term and 'didascalia' as the more formal/Instagram-specific alternate, per IT-028.
phrases.good_example: Caption TikTok aesthetic — Apri la caption con una scritta stilizzata...
phrases.avoid_when: n/a for TikTok; consider 'didascalia' for more formal/older-audience Instagram-specific copy

phrases.content_surface: throughout site — titles, meta, FAQ, UI copy
phrases.usage_guidance: Completely naturalized — 'biografia' only appears once, in the Aranzulla external source, and never natively in the UTG IT corpus. No action needed; flagged here only for completeness as one of the load-bearing borrowed terms alongside 'nickname' and 'caption'.
phrases.good_example: Bio Instagram bella
